attack_s.rationale: Synthetic smoothing time for increasing load and transient intensity.

crossfade_s.rationale: Synthetic edge blend for the bounded looping physical texture.

decay_s.rationale: Synthetic smoothing time for decreasing load and transient intensity.

fixed_output_gain.rationale: One conservative fixed gain shared by every offline schedule.

fundamental_load_floor.rationale: Synthetic minimum first-order contribution at zero load.

fundamental_load_span.rationale: Synthetic continuous first-order contribution added across normalized load.

high_order_load_floor.rationale: Synthetic minimum higher-order contribution at zero load.

high_order_load_span.rationale: Synthetic continuous higher-order contribution added across normalized load.

load_rate_reference.rationale: Synthetic normalized-load rate that drives the transient target to unity.

max_adjacent_step.rationale: Automated discontinuity proxy threshold for normalized output samples.

max_dc.rationale: Automated DC proxy threshold for normalized output samples.

output_edge_fade_s.rationale: Synthetic one-time fade at final output boundaries to prevent start and stop clicks.

rpm_rate_reference.rationale: Synthetic RPM-per-second rate that drives the transient target to unity.

stereo_order.rationale: Synthetic engine order used for the bounded stereo side texture.

stereo_order_weight.rationale: Synthetic weight of the order-driven stereo side component.

stereo_phase_rad.rationale: Synthetic phase offset in radians for the stereo order component.

stereo_texture_weight.rationale: Synthetic weight of the physical texture in the stereo side component.

stereo_width.rationale: Synthetic bounded side-component width without spatial calibration.

texture_mix.rationale: Synthetic fixed pressure-to-audition mix for the accepted PTR texture.

transient_gain.rationale: Synthetic bounded emphasis driven continuously by RPM and load derivatives.

transient_load_floor.rationale: Synthetic minimum transient audibility at zero load.

transient_load_span.rationale: Synthetic continuous transient-intensity increase across normalized load.

transient_order.rationale: Synthetic engine order carrying derivative-driven transient emphasis.

transient_phase_rad.rationale: Synthetic phase offset in radians for transient emphasis.

order_profile_entries.name: fundamental
order_profile_entries.rationale: Synthetic first-order contribution for the non-OEM reference profile.

order_profile_entries.name: second
order_profile_entries.rationale: Synthetic second-order contribution for harmonic balance.

order_profile_entries.name: third
order_profile_entries.rationale: Synthetic third-order contribution for high-load harmonic emphasis.
